commit.message:
ci(sdk): run the TypeScript SDK job when root package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml or .npmrc change (D336)

Owner decision D336 (option a): the root package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml
and .npmrc join main's case list in the Detect changed paths step (root
only). test_sdk_path_filter.py gains runs cases (each alone and with an
unrelated file) and skips for nested look-alikes and package.json.bak;
sdk/typescript/package.json still runs through sdk/typescript/*.

Red on main's sdk.yml: the 6 new runs cases fail; green: 26/26.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: citadelculture <citadelculture@gmail.com>

files.patch:
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env python3
-"""D287/D314: run sdk.yml's own "Detect changed paths" script against real
+"""D287/D314/D336: run sdk.yml's own "Detect changed paths" script against real
 git diffs and check which pull requests run the TypeScript SDK job."""
 
 import os
@@ -76,6 +76,20 @@ def git(*args: str) -> str:
     ("this workflow", [".github/workflows/sdk.yml"], True),
     ("SDK with unrelated", ["sdk/typescript/package.json", "README.md"], True),
     ("lockfile with unrelated", ["pnpm-lock.yaml", "docs/x.md"], True),
+    # D336: root workspace files, alone and with an unrelated file.
+    ("root package.json", ["package.json"], True),
+    ("root pnpm-workspace.yaml", ["pnpm-workspace.yaml"], True),
+    ("root .npmrc", [".npmrc"], True),
+    ("root package.json with unrelated", ["package.json", "README.md"], True),
+    ("root pnpm-workspace.yaml with unrelated", ["pnpm-workspace.yaml", "docs/x.md"], True),
+    ("root .npmrc with unrelated", [".npmrc", "codex-rs/core/src/lib.rs"], True),
+    # A nested SDK package.json still runs through sdk/typescript/*.
+    ("SDK package.json", ["sdk/typescript/package.json"], True),
+    # D336 look-alikes that are not the root files skip.
+    ("Python SDK package.json", ["sdk/python/package.json"], False),
+    ("devcontainer package.json", [".devcontainer/codex-install/package.json"], False),
+    ("nested .npmrc", ["sdk/python/.npmrc"], False),
+    ("package.json.bak", ["package.json.bak"], False),
     # Unrelated-only pull requests still skip.
     ("unrelated docs", ["README.md", "docs/x.md"], False),
     ("unrelated Rust", ["codex-rs/core/src/lib.rs", "codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml"], False),

@@ -81,6 +81,9 @@ jobs:
   # workflow or a lockfile the SDK build uses (pnpm-lock.yaml, codex-rs/Cargo.lock;
   # D314), build the CLI with Cargo and run them. A skipped job leaves the
   # `sdk` call successful, so it blocks `CI required` only when it runs.
+  # D336: also the root package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml and .npmrc (root
+  # only; nested look-alikes do not count), which only nightly caught.
+  # .github/scripts/test_sdk_path_filter.py runs this step's script.
   typescript-sdk-changed:
     name: Detect TypeScript SDK changes
     if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
@@ -107,6 +110,8 @@ jobs:
           while IFS= read -r f; do
             case $f in
               sdk/typescript/* | codex-rs/exec/* | .github/workflows/sdk.yml | pnpm-lock.yaml | codex-rs/Cargo.lock) run=true ;;
+              # D336: root workspace files the SDK build reads.
+              package.json | pnpm-workspace.yaml | .npmrc) run=true ;;
             esac
           done <<< "$files"
           echo "TypeScript SDK tests: $run"
